def countOilDeposits(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    visited = [[False for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]

    for i in range(rows):
        for j in range(cols):
            if grid[i][j] == '@' and not visited[i][j]:

    cols = len(grid[0])

        next_j = j + dy
        if 0 <= next_i < rows and 0 <= next_j < cols and grid[next_i][next_j] == '@' and not visited[next_i][next_j]:
